digest.component_or_area: LLM verification pipeline and review decision kernel
propositions: Tolerant Pydantic parsing in the verification pipeline can normalize structurally divergent provider responses to semantically empty results that must never produce valid pass or empty review outcomes.

Semantically empty verification responses (raw-empty or malformed-to-empty after reshape) are already routed to indeterminate by pass3_decide's no-verification rule; telemetry distinguishes empty-outcomes and unrecoverable buckets separately from clean and recovered parses.

The verify_findings kernel function already implements empty-outcome detection, StructuredOutputError handling, and all four outcome_counts buckets (clean/recovered/empty_outcomes/unrecoverable) with unit test coverage; ACs 1-5 are satisfied at the kernel level.

Pipeline-level telemetry wiring of outcome_counts into plan_review_decide and code_review_decide step-functions is not yet implemented and is tracked as a separate follow-up ticket independent of this ticket's closing scope.

Bounded retry, self-healing normalization, and recoverable non-empty responses from supported provider/model variations must remain provider-independent and deterministic while rejecting semantically empty results through decision-layer guards.
